science_vegetable: Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea

horizon_goals.immediate_session_goal: Resolve the Kelvin-Helmholtz shear instability across the ferrofluid sea before supper.
horizon_goals.mid_term_milestone: Stabilize the main colony reactor outputs.
horizon_goals.campaign_arc_climax: Achieve full synchronization of the enclave's metabolic engine.

active_location.macro_silhouette: The vast, inky expanse of the ferrofluid sea writhes under the cavern's bioluminescent glow, the magnetic surface tearing itself into jagged, fractal peaks. A heavy, humid tang of ionized ozone hangs thick in the air, tasting of old pennies on the tongue. Along the rocky shoreline, massive copper inductive coils hum with an angry, rising thrum as the Kelvin-Helmholtz shear rips the magnetic waves into chaotic, hissing breakers.

sensory_palette.sight_and_color: Inky black, jagged, bioluminescent glow, copper

interactive_features.affordance_description: Massive shore-side coils that can be tuned to stabilize the local magnetic field.
The jagged waves themselves, which can be coaxed into a rhythmic, non-destructive pattern.
Vents to dump excess energy generated by the shear.

reactive_toys.motivation_goal: To rip apart the magnetic cohesion of the sea.
reactive_toys.consistent_method: Generating chaotic, jagged waveforms and immense localized heat.
reactive_toys.immediate_complication: The shear is approaching the main heat sinks.
reactive_toys.uninterrupted_escalation: The shear will overwhelm the heat sinks and cause a cascade failure in the thermal grid.

three_levels_of_why.level_1_immediate: The shear threatens the immediate stability of the dock's thermal regulation.
three_levels_of_why.level_2_local: If the dock's thermal grid fails, the entire section will freeze over.
three_levels_of_why.level_3_campaign_arc: Mastering the ferrofluid sea's dynamics is essential for the Enclave's long-term energy independence.

judge_tactician.failure_stakes_declared: If the tuning fails, the sheer will fry the secondary induction array, forcing a complete recalibration.

graduated_outcomes.nat_1_false_intuition: Ryn misreads the thermal telemetry, causing the coils to repel rather than attract the waves.
graduated_outcomes.below_dc_complicated_fail_forward: The coils take the strain, but a copper fuse blows, requiring Silas to manually bridge the gap.
graduated_outcomes.meets_dc_clean_success: The coils hum in perfect resonance, smoothing out the jagged breakers into gentle ripples.
graduated_outcomes.dc_plus_5_or_20_extended_lore: Ryn not only stabilizes the field but discovers a hidden harmonic frequency in the ferrofluid that allows it to store thermal energy more efficiently.

master_narrator.agency_handoff_prompt: Ryn finishes tuning the last coil, wiping a smudge of copper oxide from her brow. She turns to Silas, who is bracing the manual override lever. 'It's holding, Silas. The shear is contained. I need you to lock down the primary feed before the feedback loop catches up to us. You have the baton.'
